discovery_questions: What official IBGE product provides or authoritatively defines municipality population observations for every required year?
What exact population concept is measured in each year?
What is the reference date/year for each value and how does it differ from publication date?
Which years are census counts and which are estimates or revisions?
Did methodology, territorial basis, or revision policy change over 2016-2025?
Can one official series be used homogeneously, or is an explicit adapter/rebase contract required across product regimes?
What stable municipality identifier is used by the source and how does it map to IBGE code 3526902?

candidate_product_policy.rule: Select only after official documentation proves product identity, concept, temporal coverage and revision semantics.

acceptance_rule: All 2016-2025 denominator observations must be supported by one homogeneous official concept or by an explicit, proven adapter/rebase across documented product/method regimes; silent mixing is forbidden.
rejection_rules: single 2025 estimate is not a 2016-2025 series
2022 census count cannot be copied to other years
publication year cannot silently substitute for reference year
Census and estimates cannot be mixed without explicit contract
missing year cannot be imputed silently
historical NUM_POPU values cannot be treated as IBGE-compatible by inference
